name: OUTCOME_METRIC_DENOMINATOR_AND_VERIFIER_PROVENANCE_GATE
purpose: Prevent benchmark headline rates from silently mixing evaluated, unevaluated, pending-verification and forced-completion-failure records. Make outcome denominators and verifier semantics statically recomputable from immutable row-level artifacts.
acceptance_rules: Bind the full population manifest or exact row set used by the metric, including immutable content identity and the inclusion predicate.

Every row must expose an outcome-status class such as evaluator_scored, forced_completion_failure, not_evaluated_or_pending, or excluded_with_reason; null/missing outcome values may not disappear from denominator provenance.
For every evaluator_scored row bind evaluator method, exact evaluator revision or executable rule, evaluator input identity, and produced score/label. A pending verifier is not a completed verifier.
Report population_n, eligible_n, evaluator_scored_n, forced_failure_n, pending_or_unscored_n and metric_denominator_n separately whenever they differ.

The published numerator and denominator must be exactly recomputable from row-level statuses under the declared metric rule; software-library null dropping is not a sufficient denominator specification.

Different semantics such as heuristic ground-truth overlap and no-conclusion forced failure may not be presented as one homogeneous verification success rate unless the composition is explicitly disclosed and the combined rule is named.
Difficulty/model/domain slices must carry their own coverage counts. A rate derived from one non-null row among many pending rows may not be described as the slice-wide verified success rate.
Execution completion, presence of a final claim, heuristic correctness proxy, judge verification, and scientific validity remain distinct outcomes.

observed_public_case.recomputation: 88 / 127 = 0.6929133858267716. The 127 non-null statuses comprise 126 crude ground-truth token-overlap evaluations plus one no-conclusion forced failure; 245 of 372 rows have success=null.
observed_public_case.verifier_semantics: If a final claim and ground_truth exist, success is set by whitespace-token set overlap > 0.3. If a final claim exists without ground_truth, success is null. If no final claim exists, success is false. The serialized verification field remains method=pending/result=null/score=null.
observed_public_case.scope_guard: This explains the public analysis denominator; it does not establish that the heuristic is a scientific correctness verifier or that every later OpenDiscoveryTrace release uses identical scoring semantics.

static_qc_cases.reason: Only 127/372 rows have non-null success and the completed-verification field remains pending.
Allowed only when explicitly named a crude ground-truth token-overlap proxy with coverage 126/372, not general scientific success.
The medium slice has 153 rows but its non-null success mean is driven by one forced no-conclusion false while other rows are null.
A null rate with zero non-null success labels is admissible when coverage is explicit and no success claim is made.
Population, evaluator revision, per-row labels, numerator and denominator are all immutable and complete.
